rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only candidate must preserve valid completion before lap-time gains can count.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, road and obstacle pixels, rendered speed, recent road-center change, and selected stable actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Compare four independent single-change stable-base directions: road-clearance gas floor, bend exit burst, centered-obstacle preview brake, and mild-bend outer entry.
expected_success_endpoint: Each mechanism visibly changes actions on consumed TRAIN cells without invalid actions or lost completed cells, qualifying it for a separately registered fresh tune batch.
control: Selected full-road-guard actor with exact checkpoint hash on the same two TRAIN cells.
falsifier: No action change, invalid action, or new nonfinish relative to the control on a registered cell.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five profiles × consumed TRAIN 1/43 and 2/102, ten episodes and 2000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, registered 1800-second limit, TRAIN only and no external action.
